from scipy.optimize import least_squares
forms={
'quad+exp':lambda p:p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P**2+p[3]*np.exp(p[4]*P),
'cub+exp':lambda p:p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P**2+p[5]*P**3+p[3]*np.exp(p[4]*P),
'quad+sin':lambda p:p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P**2+p[3]*np.sin(p[4]*P+p[5]),
'quad+hill':lambda p:p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P**2+p[3]*P**2/(p[4]**2+P**2),
'quad+mm':lambda p:p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P**2+p[3]*P/(abs(p[4])+P),
'quad+pow':lambda p:p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P**2+p[3]*P**p[4],
'quad+log':lambda p:p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P**2+p[3]*np.log(1+abs(p[4])*P),
'quad+tanh':lambda p:p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P**2+p[3]*np.tanh(p[4]*P+p[5]),
'gomp':lambda p:p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P**2+p[3]*P*np.log(P),
'cub+hill':lambda p:p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P**2+p[5]*P**3+p[3]*P**2/(p[4]**2+P**2),
}
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
for k,f in forms.items():
    best=(1,None)

        p0=rng.normal(0,1,6)

from scipy.optimize import least_squares
import time
C=lambda p:p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P**2+p[3]*P**3
Q=lambda p:p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P**2
forms={
'cub+sin':(lambda p:C(p)+p[4]*np.sin(p[5]*P+p[6]),7),
'cub+gauss':(lambda p:C(p)+p[4]*np.exp(-abs(p[5])*P**2),6),
'cub+mm':(lambda p:C(p)+p[4]*P/(abs(p[5])+P),6),
'quad+PexpP':(lambda p:Q(p)+p[4]*P*np.exp(p[5]*P),6),
'quad+P2expP':(lambda p:Q(p)+p[4]*P*P*np.exp(p[5]*P),6),
'quad+hill3':(lambda p:Q(p)+p[4]*P**3/(abs(p[5])+P**3),6),
'quad+cos':(lambda p:Q(p)+p[4]*np.cos(p[5]*P),6),
'quad+gauss':(lambda p:Q(p)+p[4]*np.exp(-abs(p[5])*P**2),6),
}
rng=np.random.default_rng(1)
t0=time.time()
for k,(f,n) in forms.items():
    best=(1,None)
    for s in range(4):
        if time.time()-t0>15: break
        p0=rng.normal(0,1,n)
        try:
            o=least_squares(lambda p:f(p)-dP_dt,p0,max_nfev=300)
            v=np.mean(o.fun**2)/np.var(dP_dt)
            if v<best[0]:best=(v,o.x)
        except Exception as e: pass
    print(k,best[0],np.round(best[1],5) if best[1] is not None else None)
